title: Common providers: Portugal
coverage: Complete for the four network operators (fixed and mobile) and the cable operator; wholesale rural fibre networks and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Operators that serve only Madeira or the Azores
Rural wholesale fibre networks other than dstelecom
An AS number for DIGI (none confirmed)
A website for Claranet Portugal (it did not answer)

sources.name: ANACOM: registered providers of electronic communications
sources.terms: The site did not answer an automated read on the read date and its terms were not read: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Not read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Portugal
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 2 of 12 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Portugal
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 2 of 12 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 11 of 12 websites answered one plain automated request; an address that did not answer, or that refused it, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 14 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE Database full-text search (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The database terms were not read on the read date: nothing is copied. Searched by company name to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as the entries above and below say.
sources.result: Candidate numbers found for some providers; none was taken without the confirmation.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: Total Telecom: Digi Portugal and Nowo
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above (article of 5 August 2024): Digi agreed to buy Nowo. The completion date was not read.

providers.name: MEO
providers.notes: The incumbent; fixed and mobile. AS15525 is its business network and AS42863 its mobile network.

providers.name: DIGI
providers.notes: Fibre and mobile; the fourth network operator.

providers.name: NOWO
providers.notes: Cable. DIGI agreed to buy it in August 2024; it still traded under its own name on the read date.

providers.name: Claranet Portugal
providers.notes: Uses the AS number of Claranet (registered in the United Kingdom).

providers.name: dstelecom
providers.notes: Wholesale rural fibre network; retail through other providers.
